Use the real structured edit tool. Return ONLY JSON {"edits":[{"node":"an actual node ID from the source catalogue","changes":{}}]}. No fences or prose. One to sixteen node edits; no whole files or whole functions.
Repair owner flow. touch(buf:Vec<u8>,x:u8)->Vec<u8> receives a nonempty zeroed Vec, writes x+1 modulo 256 into byte 0 and returns the same Vec without a new allocation. entrypoint(a:u32,b:u32,c:u32)->u64 creates one zeroed Vec of length (a AND 7)+1, transfers it once to touch with low byte of b, then reads the RETURNED owner and returns its byte0 plus 16*its_length. c is ignored. Release the owner before returning. Never read the moved original owner.
The task's references to files mean their editable symbols; this interface accepts node edits only.
Every Rust edit uses changes:{"text":"complete replacement fragment"}. Rust replacements are complete expression or type fragments. Preserve unselected syntax; include explicit parentheses when needed to keep surrounding precedence. Parameter/return types are read-only unless policy is migrate.
